question: Can the existing Wingless bounded-state substrate learn a next-token transition law directly from sequence observations and reproduce the same learned predictive behavior across the independently qualified slice-backed and fixed-capacity ring context containers?
hypothesis: Across a frozen deterministic token corpus, both substrate implementations will learn the same two-token next-token map from training observations, reach at least 0.95 held-out-sequence next-token accuracy, exceed the untrained deterministic baseline by at least 0.70, and disagree on zero learned predictions, learned counts, or context-state observables.

prior_evidence.scientific_claim: Slice-backed and fixed-capacity ring deques were exactly invariant on the frozen bounded state-transition observables.

authority: research-only; no production, broker, live, accepted-ref, credential, runner-configuration, scheduler, queue-consumer, or cross-lane authority changes

native_learning_rule.learned_state: integer transition-count tensor indexed by two-token context and candidate next token; no target-law parameters are exposed to the learner
native_learning_rule.prediction: argmax learned transition count for the current two-token context; ties resolve to the lowest token id
native_learning_rule.update: increment exactly one observed context->next count per training transition

training_corpus.starts: all 64 ordered two-token contexts exactly once
training_corpus.order: deterministic seed-derived permutation of the 64 starts followed by deterministic recurrence rollout

evaluation_corpus.starts: same 64 context support, independently permuted and rolled forward after training; evaluation does not update learned state
evaluation_corpus.held_out_property: sequence trajectories and ordering are disjoint from training rollout while the finite two-token support is intentionally covered during training; this experiment tests acquisition and generation consistency, not unseen-context compositional generalization

controls: Both substrates receive byte-for-byte identical ordered training and evaluation token observations for each seed.
The target recurrence is used only to generate corpus tokens and score predictions; the learner receives only observed token triples.
The untrained baseline uses the same argmax rule over an all-zero learned tensor and therefore deterministically predicts token 0.
Training mutates only the bounded transition-count tensor; evaluation is read-only.
No external model calls, language labels, oracle corrections, gradient optimizer, capacity growth, or post-result changes are permitted.

budgets.goroutine_policy: single-process deterministic execution; GOMAXPROCS=1 in qualification

validity_criteria: Exact parent SHA and updated North Star SHA-256 match this preregistration.
All eight seeds and both substrates complete the frozen training and evaluation cardinalities.
Training data and evaluation data are generated deterministically from the frozen recurrence and seed schedule.
The learner has no access to the recurrence coefficients except through observed sequence transitions.
Both substrate implementations share only corpus observations and comparison helpers; context push/pop mechanics remain independently implemented.
Learned tensor size stays exactly 512 counters and context capacity exactly two tokens.
The normalized result carries schema wingless.research-scientific-result.v1 and exact experiment identifier.
Full Go regression passes before probe execution.

classification_rules.supported: All twelve frozen metric thresholds and all validity criteria pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and deterministic completion pass, both substrates learn above baseline, but at least one accuracy or exact cross-substrate equivalence threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but native learned prediction fails to exceed the frozen baseline threshold or exhibits material substrate-dependent behavior.
classification_rules.incomplete: Environmental or compute interruption prevents full frozen cardinality; preserve diagnostics and make no scientific claim.
classification_rules.invalid: Provenance, frozen-package identity, construction, determinism, bounded-state, or qualification isolation fails; invalid is not a scientific outcome.

stop_conditions: Stop before execution on identity, provenance, authority, or package-scope drift.
Stop as invalid on malformed corpus construction, context capacity violation, learned-state cardinality drift, or non-deterministic qualification.
Do not stop early for apparent support, mixed, or negative observations; complete the full frozen matrix unless infrastructure prevents it.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: After any probe or primary output is observed, do not alter seeds, corpus construction, recurrence, context width, alphabet, learning rule, prediction rule, capacities, metrics, thresholds, aggregation, classification, or stop conditions under this experiment identifier.
invalid_reason: The preregistration claimed held-out evaluation trajectories while specifying the same deterministic recurrence rollouts from the same 64 starts for training and evaluation. No primary or diagnostic probe was executed.
